comment: The panel prints the eight stage outputs as binary numbers 000 to 111; those are stage numbers, not the register's contents. Each CV output is fed by four of the eight stages and each stage feeds two CV outputs (8BitCipher.cpp:118-157), so the four CV outputs move together but never alike. The maker's own summary in plugin.json calls this a dual sequencer and clock divider, which is the 4Seq text repeated; the panel subtitle, Random Voltage Source, matches what the code does.
